newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes lower on overseas trend.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes lower on overseas trend.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished lower on Wednesday, responding belatedly to the U.S. dollar's persistent strength in overseas markets, dealers said.
The local unit closed at T$27.594 against Tuesday's T$27.582 end. Turnover through dealers was US$293 million.
"The Taiwan dollar has been mired in directionless trade for a long time. Now it cannot resist the U.S. dollar's persistent strength overseas," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
Dealers expected the local unit to depreciate slowly in the near term. A range of T$27.58-62 was seen for Thursday.
